1. About these terms

KenganSocial is operated by MiraiStack (registration number K2025971590), a company registered in the Republic of South Africa and based in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. These Terms of Service ("Terms") are an agreement between you and MiraiStack ("we", "us") for your use of KenganSocial at https://kengansocial.co.za (the "Platform").

By creating an account you accept these Terms and our Privacy Policy (https://kengansocial.co.za/privacy). If you accept them for a business or a client, you confirm you are authorised to bind them.

2. The service

KenganSocial helps creators, businesses and agencies to: — connect Instagram, Facebook Pages, Meta ad accounts, TikTok and YouTube accounts; — create, edit, publish and schedule posts and videos; — reply to comments and direct messages, by hand or with automations they configure; — view analytics and ad results, and manage ad campaigns they confirm; — work with team members and clients in shared workspaces.

Some features depend on the social platforms' APIs, which they can change or limit. We are not responsible for a platform's changes, outages or decisions, but we will tell you when a feature is affected.

3. Your account

You must be at least 18, give accurate information, and keep your login secure. You are responsible for activity in your account and workspaces, including by members you invite.

Tell us at once at support@kengansocial.co.za if you suspect unauthorised access. Creating several accounts to avoid plan limits is not allowed.

4. Connected social accounts

You may only connect accounts, Pages and ad accounts that you own or are authorised to manage. When you connect one, you authorise us to act on it as the features you use require, for example to publish the content you schedule or send the replies your automations produce.

You must follow each platform's rules when you use KenganSocial, including the Meta Platform Terms and Community Standards, the TikTok Terms of Service and Community Guidelines, and the YouTube Terms of Service (https://www.youtube.com/t/terms). By connecting YouTube you agree to the YouTube Terms of Service.

You can disconnect an account at any time on the Connections page.

5. Messaging and automation rules

Automations must only reply to people who have contacted you first, within the reply windows the platforms set (for example, Meta allows replies within 24 hours of a person's last message, and TikTok within 48 hours). KenganSocial enforces these windows.

You must not use KenganSocial to send spam or unsolicited bulk messages, to mislead people about who they are talking to, to collect sensitive information without consent, or to message people who asked you to stop. When someone replies STOP or a similar opt-out word, automations stop messaging them.

You are responsible for the content of your replies and templates, including AI-written replies you allow to send automatically.

6. Meta ads

If you connect a Meta ad account, KenganSocial will only create, edit or pause campaigns, ad sets, ads or budgets after you confirm the action. You remain the advertiser: you are responsible for your ads' content, targeting and compliance with Meta's Advertising Standards, and for all ad spend, which Meta bills to you directly. We are not liable for ad spend or ad results.

7. Acceptable use

You must not use the Platform to: — break any law or anyone's rights, including copyright and privacy; — publish content that is illegal, hateful, harassing, sexually explicit involving minors, or deceptive; — harm, overload or try to gain unauthorised access to the Platform, other workspaces or connected accounts; — get around platform or KenganSocial rate limits, or resell the Platform without our written agreement.

We may suspend or close accounts that break these rules and report illegal activity to the authorities.

8. Your content

You keep ownership of everything you upload or create. You give us a limited licence to store, process and transmit it only as needed to run the Platform for you, for example to render a video or publish a post. We do not use your content to train AI models.

You confirm you have the rights needed for content you publish, including music, footage and images. Review AI-generated content before you publish it; we do not guarantee it is accurate or original.

9. Plans and payment

We offer a free plan and paid plans. Prices and limits are shown at https://kengansocial.co.za/pricing. Paid plans are billed in advance in South African Rand through Paystack, including VAT where applicable. Usage allowances reset each billing period and do not roll over.

You can cancel at any time by emailing billing@kengansocial.co.za (the Billing page links to it); cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period. First-time subscribers may cancel within 7 days for a full refund. Under section 14 of the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008 you may cancel a fixed-term agreement with 20 business days' notice.

10. Privacy and data protection

Our Privacy Policy (https://kengansocial.co.za/privacy) explains how we handle personal information and forms part of these Terms.

For your audience's comments and messages, you are the responsible party under POPIA and we process that information on your instructions. You must have a lawful reason to process it and must tell your audience how you use it.

11. Ending the agreement

You can delete your account at any time in Settings. We may suspend or close your account if you seriously or repeatedly break these Terms, if the law requires it, or if your use puts others at risk. Where reasonable, we will warn you first.

When an account is deleted, we delete its data as described in the Privacy Policy.

12. Liability

The Platform is provided "as is". To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, lost profits or data, or losses caused by social platforms, and our total liability is limited to the fees you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.

Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, including under the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008, or liability for gross negligence or fraud.

13. Disputes and governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of South Africa. We will first try to resolve any dispute by negotiation. If that fails within 30 days, either party may refer it to mediation, and then to arbitration, under the rules of the Arbitration Foundation of Southern Africa (AFSA), without affecting your rights under the Consumer Protection Act.

14. Changes

If we make a material change to these Terms, we will email account owners at least 30 days before it takes effect. If you do not agree, you may cancel before then.
